result.title: HORIA: 4D Human and Object Reconstruction from a Monocular Video with Interaction-Aware Re-Rendering
result.summary: Joint 4D reconstruction of a human and object from a monocular video is essential for understanding how people interact with their environment. While recent methods have made noticeable progress, capturing such human-object interactions remains difficult due to two main challenges. First, a video typically contains composite semantic context spanning multiple interaction phases, making it difficult to track the temporal changes of the interaction in the reconstruction. Second, under human-object occlusion, a single-view observation contains incomplete visual information about the interaction, resulting in geometrically inconsistent reconstructions. To address these challenges, we introduce HORIA, built upon two core designs. First, we decompose the entire input video into temporally grounded and semantically distinct interaction phases with motion-aware captioning, obtaining a specific text description for each phase. Second, conditioned on these text descriptions of the interaction, we propose an interaction-aware re-rendering that compensates for the limited single-view observation. Specifically, we render the initially reconstructed 4D human and object from novel viewpoints and refine the renderings with a text-to-video diffusion prior, which provides auxiliary novel-view supervision beyond single-view cues. As a result, our framework produces temporally coherent and accurate 4D reconstructions under diverse interaction scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.brief_summary: HORIA 研究从单目视频中联合重建人与物体的 4D 几何：先用带动作感知标注将视频切分为语义交互阶段，再以文本条件化重渲染并用 text-to-video 扩散先验提供新视角监督，缓解遮挡下的几何不一致。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作面向 4D 几何重建与遮挡补全，目标是重建精度与时间一致性，未涉及 VLM 推理状态、latent 生成/使用或证据获取与停止决策，未发现可供 LVR 核查的具体方法线索。
